entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 6,790 star（日均约 970，相对存量增速 5.1%），累计 134,172 star、8,574 fork。窗口内被 fork 559 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，472 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 6,790 stars over the last 7 days (~970/day, 5.1% of its base), now at 134,172 stars and 8,574 forks. 559 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 472 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款面向 AI 代理的 IDE，支持在桌面、移动端和远程运行你的机器人。你可以把自己的 Claude、Grok、Codex 等模型接入其中，让机器人在 Slack、Linear 或 GitHub 上帮你修复 bug，甚至在手机上收到提醒并回复。
intro.en: Orca is an AI‑agent IDE that runs on desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes. Plug in your own Claude, Grok, Codex, or other models and let bots fix bugs in Slack, Linear, or GitHub, or get notified on your phone and reply from anywhere.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 代理 IDE，支持多平台、远程、移动交互。
cardLine.en: All‑in‑one AI agent IDE for desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes.

highlights.zh: 在 Slack 或 GitHub 里直接调用机器人修复 bug，返回已测试的 PR。
highlights.en: Invoke bots in Slack or GitHub to fix bugs and get a tested pull request.

highlights.zh: 支持 Chat UI 与 CLI 双模式，随时切换不丢失上下文。
highlights.en: Switch between chat UI and CLI without losing context.

highlights.zh: 可将远程 Orca 服务器与任何 SSH 主机或云 VM 配对，代理持续运行。
highlights.en: Pair a remote Orca server with any SSH host or cloud VM for continuous agent execution.

highlights.zh: 移动 App 让你在离开桌面时也能收到推送并回复，保持工作流不间断。
highlights.en: Mobile app sends push notifications and lets you reply on the go, keeping the workflow continuous.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 9,356 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 9,356 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,158 star（日均约 451，相对存量增速 2.1%），累计 152,390 star、14,650 fork。窗口内被 fork 372 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，407 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,158 stars over the last 7 days (~451/day, 2.1% of its base), now at 152,390 stars and 14,650 forks. 372 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 407 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 能把整个代码库（代码、文档、PDF、SQL 等）转成可查询的知识图谱，帮助你快速定位依赖、理解模块关系。
intro.en: Graphify turns a codebase—code, docs, PDFs, SQL—into a queryable knowledge graph, making it easy to trace dependencies and understand module relationships.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库映射成可查询的知识图谱，支持多 AI 代理调用。
cardLine.en: Map a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph, usable by many AI agents.

highlights.zh: 基于 tree‑sitter 的 AST 解析，完全本地、确定性，无 LLM 参与。

highlights.en: Edges are labeled EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so you know what was read directly.

highlights.zh: 支持代码、文档、PDF、图像、视频等多种文件类型的语义映射。
highlights.en: Handles code, docs, PDFs, images, videos, and more for semantic mapping.

highlights.zh: 可通过 `/graphify` 在 AI 助手中即时生成图谱，帮助快速定位问题。

intro.zh: Agent Reach 是一款让 AI 代理直接访问并抓取互联网内容的工具。它支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，免去繁琐的 API 调用与登录流程。只需一条命令，代理即可搜索、读取、获取结构化数据，适用于任何 CLI 代理。
intro.en: Agent Reach is a tool that lets AI agents directly access and scrape internet content. It supports platforms like Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, and more, eliminating the need for complex API calls and login steps. With a single command, agents can search, read, and retrieve structured data, suitable for any CLI agent.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 代理直接抓取 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube 等平台内容，一条命令即可使用。
cardLine.en: Enable AI agents to scrape Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, and more with a single command.

highlights.zh: 一次安装即可支持多平台抓取，免去单独编写爬虫。
highlights.en: One installation supports multi-platform scraping, eliminating the need for separate crawlers.

highlights.zh: 自动使用本地浏览器登录，保证账号安全且不影响主浏览器。
highlights.en: Automatically uses local browser sessions for login, keeping accounts safe and not affecting the main browser.

highlights.zh: 提供结构化数据输出，如 GitHub 仓库信息、YouTube 字幕、Bilibili 视频详情。
highlights.en: Outputs structured data such as GitHub repo info, YouTube subtitles, and Bilibili video details.

highlights.zh: 支持可选渠道，按需添加小红书、LinkedIn 等平台，命令式扩展。

entries.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,730 star（日均约 247，相对存量增速 1.7%），累计 99,032 star、6,776 fork。窗口内被 fork 145 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,730 stars over the last 7 days (~247/day, 1.7% of its base), now at 99,032 stars and 6,776 forks. 145 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Archify 是一款让任何想法、计划或代码库变成交互式图表的工具。你只需向 AI 代理描述需求，它就会生成可探索、可定制、可分享的 HTML 视觉化。
intro.en: Archify turns any idea, plan, or codebase into an interactive diagram. Describe your concept to an AI agent and it produces a customizable, shareable HTML visual.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 代理把想法变成可交互的图表。
cardLine.en: Turn ideas into interactive diagrams with an AI agent.

highlights.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等多种代理，使用极其灵活。
highlights.en: Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and more.

highlights.zh: 生成的图表可导出 PNG/WEBP/JPG 或 PDF，方便分享和打印。
highlights.en: Export diagrams as PNG/WEBP/JPG or PDF for easy sharing.

highlights.zh: 可根据用户指令动态更新图表，如添加认证步骤或切换主题。
highlights.en: Dynamically update diagrams (e.g., add auth steps, switch themes) via agent commands.

highlights.zh: 支持源代码引用，所有断言都带编号来源，便于验证和检查。
highlights.en: Source-backed assertions with numbered citations for easy verification.

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

fitFor.zh: 需要可扩展抽象层而非端到端方案的团队
fitFor.en: Teams wanting an extensible abstraction layer rather than a turnkey app
